'''Synon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Deadeyes]], [[Republic Army]] [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]]. When the Deadeyes were captured by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] as part of the plan by SIS Agent [[Zane (SIS)|Zane]] to trace their locations to [[Dusk 9]], they were split the captives and Synon ended up with [[Torve]] and [[Miev]] imprisoned at a work camp on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] until they were rescued by their formed squadmate [[Aric Jorgan]], now a member of [[Havoc Squad]].<ref name="TOR" />
